instruction.text: Lies den Text von Isha und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: My sister and I have lived alone with our father since I can remember. We have always been a very happy family with our father as a single parent. However, Dad has been dating a woman for a few months now and everything has changed. I don't like her at all. I feel like she spends so much time with Dad that he might forget about us one day. I really don't want to have a stepmother.

atoms.a: How can you describe the family?
b: ++single-parent family
traditional family
patchwork family

atoms.a: What is Isha struggling with at the moment?
b: ++accepting a new person in his own and his father's life
seeing his father happier than before
++feeling left out when his father and his girlfriend spend time without him

instruction.text: Lies den Text von Hatima und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: My parents and I have been living in the UK for eight years, but I was born in Syria. Unlike me, my family is Islamic and very religious which sometimes makes it difficult for us to get along. Although I lived in Syria for five years, I feel more connected to British culture. My parents find it hard to accept that I don't want to wear traditional Islamic clothing. Fortunately, I have great friends that help me feel confident as the person I am.

atoms.a: What are the differences between Hatima and her parents?
b: ++the culture and religion they feel connected with
the country they live in
the family they are surrounded by

atoms.a: What helps Hatima to be herself instead of acting according to her parents' beliefs?
b: ++her friends that make her feel confident
her grandparents that give her money to buy her own clothes
her parents telling her that she can be whoever she wants
